workInProgress: 2026-08-23: Three exact saved-view visual attempts have been made and the issue remains open. The GPU boundary-ownership repair fixed a real CPU/GPU topology defect and the full GPU oracle subsequently passed all 14 cases, but attempt 3 was visually indistinguishable from attempt 2: the broad blue-gray terrain and coarse contour/spiral bands remained. The required post-three-attempt bare-bones reproduction was then extended to emitted vertex payloads. Graphics-enabled run 32682777767 passed sourceStep 1 and 2 for triangle positions/topology, packed material, normals, and finite-normal checks, ruling out a CPU/GPU extractor payload mismatch. An exact 1293x718 replay with VOXEL_DISABLE_GPU_CUTOVER=1 also converged on the CPU mesher and still showed the same class of contour/spiral banding, so the remaining defect is shared CPU/GPU reconstruction rather than GPU arena/draw-specific. Source inspection identified a coarse-density phase problem: lattice positions are SourceStep-spaced, but the shared smooth density kernel always samples fixed +/-1 and +/-2 authoritative-voxel taps. For a flat layer at SourceStep 2, moving the authoritative surface upward one voxel moves the reconstructed crossing only about 0.14 voxel (approximately 0.93 to 1.07), collapsing fine height changes toward the midpoint of each coarse edge and producing two-voxel contour terraces. The focused regression on ci-test/sceneissue-014011-coarse-lod-1 encodes that invariant, but its latest run 32684316808 did not execute the assertion because the self-hosted runner found the developer Unity editor and import workers still open and correctly refused to launch a second editor. A separate validation branch, ci-test/sceneissue-014011-coarse-phase-fix-1, now carries a CPU/GPU prototype that preserves the existing smoothing sign/topology decision while replacing only coarse-edge magnitude with nearest fine occupancy-crossing phase; its regression also covers every sub-step phase at SourceStep 2/4/8. Do not port that production prototype to fixes until the untouched repro branch records the expected red failure and the validation branch is green. After that, rerun the full GPU parity oracle and the exact saved Showcase Camera view before considering this issue fixed.
